name: cfblog
description: WordPress-like integrated blog system using Cloudflare Workers + D1 + R2

scripts.admin:build: npm run admin:typecheck && vite build --config admin/vite.config.ts
scripts.dev: npm run admin:build && npx wrangler dev --local
scripts.dev:remote: npm run admin:build && npx wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: npm run admin:build && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.db:migrate: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply cfblog-db
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply cfblog-db --remote
